title: Numbers we reported before, checked with GAB v1.1
intro: Each row is a number from an earlier report. GAB was run on the same practice-set recordings with the same build and the same scorer rules. 'yes' means GAB gets the same number. Rows measured on recordings that are now in the held-out test set (Renton Oct 11, Fremont test sessions) quote only the number reported at the time; they are not re-checked here and no test-set number is published.

rows.what: Kirtan: right Shabad on screen, Level-2 set
rows.where: 41 L2 clips, rescore.js (Shabad id match), Oct 6 build
rows.why: rescore.js matched Shabad ids; GAB matches the words, so clip38 (the same Kabir salok shown from another Shabad) counts as right. SANGAT-VIEW.md already reported 98.5% with the word match: GAB gets exactly that.
Same 23.6 s/h as SANGAT-VIEW.md; the 0.84% was the id match (copies counted wrong).

rows.what: Kirtan: found within 10 s, Level-2 set
rows.where: 41 L2 clips, from the sheet's labelled pangti
rows.gab: 38 of 41, never 0 (same timing rule); v1.1 headline: 13.3 s typical from when the app starts
rows.why: The labelled pangti is inside the Shabad and the 30 s before it is the same Shabad, so timing from it mostly shows 'already found'. v1.1 times it from when the app starts listening. 35 vs 38: id vs word match (clip38) and later builds.

rows.what: Fremont kirtan, sangat sees the right pangti (dev sessions)
rows.why: GAB v1.0 showed 37.6% because it counted the 9 clips where nothing was ever shown as 0% and added the train sessions. v1.1 counts them apart, like the report.

rows.what: Fremont kirtan, line hold on held-out test
rows.gab: test split: not re-checked on the leaderboard
rows.why: Held-out test sessions: quoted as reported. The dev rows above use the same scorer path and match exactly.

Matches SANGAT-VIEW exactly. aarti-score ignored the time after the Aarti ends inside a clip (e.g. Shabad 287 shown while 4967 is sung), so its wrong % was lower. Fast Aarti's known trade-off (more wrong time) shows here: 42.7 -> 55.6 s/h.

rows.gab: L2 0.66%; Aarti-50 1.2% (1.5% with fast Aarti); Fremont laptop mic 6.8%
rows.why: True for Level-2 livestream kirtan. Aarti and Fremont room-mic recordings are above 1% when every second is scored.
